Model I/O calculates surface normal vectors based on vertex positions using the common definition: The surface normal to a triangle is the normalized cross product of two sides of the triangle.

segments.contextAfter: `creaseThreshold`: A value between `0.0` and `1.0` that determines the smoothness of normal generation between adjacent faces. Lower values interpolate sharper angles between faces into smooth surfaces, and higher values smooth only between faces that are nearly parallel. A value of `1.0` prevents smoothing, resulting in a faceted appearance.
